Specification: This module models a small TLC-oriented specification used to test constant-context caching of derived expressions. It defines a global counter via TLCSet and TLCGet, increments that counter whenever the helper operator inc(...) is evaluated, and then wraps two set-valued definitions in TLCCache to ensure they are evaluated only once even when referenced from assumptions and behavior predicates. The specification checks that one cached definition contains 5, the other does not, initializes variables x and y from those cached definitions, and in Next asserts that both definitions are available while the counter value is exactly 2, demonstrating that each cached definition was evaluated exactly once.
